title: Degree estimate for a finite tower over a field
statement: Let $K$ be a field and let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ be finite morphisms [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For each $y\in Y$, suppose $\dim_{\kappa(y)}\Gamma(X_y,\mathcal O_{X_y})\le n$, with the fibre and its scalar action as in [def-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-bound]. Then $\dim_K\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)\le n\dim_K\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$, where the actions come from $g\circ f$ and $g$.

proof.text: The finite structure morphisms make X and Y affine. Write B=Gamma(Y,O) and A=Gamma(X,O), with K -> B -> A induced by g and f. B is a finite-dimensional K-algebra.

B is Artinian and is the finite product of its localizations B_i at maximal ideals. Each B_i is finite-dimensional and Artinian local with nilpotent maximal ideal m_i. Tensor this product decomposition with A to get A = product A_i, where A_i=A tensor_B B_i. All decompositions preserve the K action.

The affine fibre product formula identifies the fibre over the corresponding point of Spec B with Spec(A_i/m_i A_i). Its dimension over the residue field is d_i <= n by hf, using the canonical global sections isomorphisms over that field.

Lift a residue-field basis of size d_i to A_i. The resulting B_i-linear map B_i^{d_i} -> A_i is surjective modulo m_i and hence surjective by nilpotent Nakayama. Restrict scalars to K to get dim_K A_i <= d_i dim_K B_i <= n dim_K B_i.

Dimensions add across the finite products. Sum the local estimates to get dim_K A <= n dim_K B, which is exactly the finrankΓ inequality. If Y is empty both section rings are zero and the sum is empty. When n=0 every local quotient is zero and Nakayama gives A_i=0.
